newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela minister warns utilities on rate rise.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela minister warns utilities on rate rise.

text.p: A planned increase in Venezuelan electricity tariffs will fall short of the power industry's proposals, Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta said on Thursday.
"Of course it will be," Arrieta told reporters when asked if a pending rate increase would be lower than what electricity companies had requested.

Officials at the Venezuelan Electricity Industry Chamber (Caveinel) have said they are hoping for an average increase of 40 to 50 percent. Power companies have said they urgently need an increase in tariffs to meet their rising costs.
Arrieta said rates would not be increased as much as the companies wanted because their calculations included "elements which should not be part of the equation."
"When we have the figure, when we have all the arguments, we will announce it," he said.
